title: Shared representative equation for derived reduction comparisons
statement: Let B,C,D,E be abelian categories with their chosen derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let F:B→C and G:D→E be exact additive functors, and RX:B→D and RY:C→E additive functors. Let MY:D(B)→D(D) and MX:D(C)→D(E), and let cX_P:MY(QP)→Q(RX(P)) and cY_P:MX(QP)→Q(RY(P)) be specified component families. For an ordinary comparison e:RX⋙G≅F⋙RY, a derived comparison τ:MY⋙D(G)≅D(F)⋙MX, and a complex P of B, define DerivedReductionComparisonFormula to mean τ_QP followed by MX of the exact localization factor of F and cY_FP equals D(G)(cX_P) followed by the exact localization factor of G at RX(P) and Q of the termwise ordinary comparison. The localization factors are those of [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. This names exactly this equation, without asserting it or choosing any map.

proof.text: Name the displayed equality of the two composites. Both have source MY(QP) after derived G and target Q(F(P) followed by RY), using the given ordinary comparison to identify the endpoint. No existence or invertibility assertion is added. Specializing the four categories, functors and counits gives verbatim the previous StratumReductionFormula equation.

lean.statement:
def DerivedReductionComparisonFormula
    {B C D E : Type*} [Category B] [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    [Abelian B] [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [Abelian E]
    [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    [HasDerivedCategory D] [HasDerivedCategory E]
    (F : B ⥤ C) (G : D ⥤ E) (RX : B ⥤ D) (RY : C ⥤ E)
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [RX.Additive] [RY.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G] [PreservesFiniteColimits G]
    (MY : DerivedCategory B ⥤ DerivedCategory D)
    (MX : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory E)
    (cX : ∀ P : CochainComplex B ℤ, MY.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((RX.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (cY : ∀ P : CochainComplex C ℤ, MX.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((RY.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (e : RX ⋙ G ≅ F ⋙ RY)
    (τ : MY ⋙ G.mapDerivedCategory ≅ F.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ MX)
    (P : CochainComplex B ℤ) : Prop
